finding: The additive phrase fallback preserved perfect refusal on the ten frozen absent-answer traps, but it recovered no final answer and introduced one irrelevant supported answer. DeBERTa reduced noise but did not verify whether a grounded claim answered the owner's question.
decision: Do not integrate the phrase fallback into the desktop application. Keep the previously accepted technical-anchor search at 3/4 and treat question-to-claim relevance as an unresolved harness module.
privacy: Only aggregate counts and the architectural decision are public. Questions, excerpts, identifiers, model traces and complete answers remain on the owner's Mac.
claim_boundary: One private 30-question development run on one owner's evolving local library; not a locked population estimate.
